owner.title: If the owner key is stolen
owner.lede: Run for real on {vault}. An attacker holding the owner key tries to drain it, then to dump it into the stablecoin at half price. The timelock, the exit floor and the guardian stop both.

steps.title: Attacker asks to withdraw 5 NEAR
steps.detail: Signed with the stolen owner key. The contract queues it behind the timelock instead of paying out.

steps.title: Attacker tries to take it now
steps.detail: Same key, applying the withdrawal straight away.
steps.result: Refused: Timelock has not passed yet

steps.title: Attacker dumps 1 wNEAR into USDT at half price
steps.detail: The owner's instant crash exit, asking only 0.5 USDT per wNEAR. The exit floor is 90% of the last guard-signed rate, so the contract refuses it.

steps.title: Guardian vetoes the withdrawal
steps.detail: A separate account sees the queued withdrawal and cancels it.

steps.title: Guardian pauses trading
steps.detail: Instant. Only the owner can resume, and resuming waits for the timelock.

steps.title: Guardian tries to withdraw for itself
steps.detail: A stolen guardian key is no better: it can't move funds.
steps.result: Refused: Only the owner can do this

guard.title: If the guard key leaks
guard.lede: The owner's response, on the same vault right after. Pausing and rotating are instant. Turning trading back on waits out the timelock, even for the owner.

steps.title: Pause trading
steps.detail: Owner turns the kill switch on. Tightening, so it applies at once.

steps.title: Rotate the guard key
steps.detail: Owner installs a new guard key. Quotes signed by the old key stop verifying straight away.

steps.title: Ask to resume
steps.detail: Loosening, so the contract queues it behind the 10-minute timelock.

steps.title: Try to apply it early
steps.detail: Owner tries to skip the wait.
steps.result: Refused: Timelock has not passed yet

steps.title: The agent tries to trade during the pause
steps.detail: A normal $1.50 trade, signed with the new guard key. The vault is paused, so the contract refuses it.

steps.title: Apply it after the timelock
steps.detail: Ten minutes later the owner applies the queued change. Trading resumes with the new guard key.
